title: Trace descriptor alias reads during native dispatch
changes: Add a native-dispatch-only trace mode to the recorded descriptor-alias battle comparison while retaining the complete unfiltered regression.
validation: Windows GNU build ow46xo2j and Wine 049hqes5 passed the 240-frame raw/managed pair: all five typed row requests occurred during generated dispatch without interpreter instruction scope; no traced raw, unclassified or dropped requests. State, clock, video, OAM and five nonempty audio streams matched each frame.
The shared unfiltered 240-frame regression t8kj9i3n passed with the same five typed requests. Both Wine units protected inputs, removed scratch and drained Wine.
limitations: An unscoped read during generated dispatch does not by itself identify a guest PC or exclude every nested non-interpreter helper. Exact per-instruction attribution, other routes, ordinary batch reachability and other platforms remain open.
